filters.title: Filters
filters.text: Narrow the list. Each filter shows how many leads it holds. 'All open' hides cases already granted.

search.title: Search
search.text: Type a name, case number or ancestor. Works together with the active filter.

stats.title: Counts
stats.text: Live totals across all leads, recalculated whenever a lead moves stage or is updated.

views.title: Table or board
views.text: Table lists every lead in one row. Board groups them by stage, and you can drag a card to move it. Both show the same filtered leads.

nav.title: Moving between leads
nav.text: The arrows step to the previous or next lead in the current filter, so you can work through a list without going back.

edit.title: Edit details & password
edit.text: Correct the name, email or phone, or email the applicant a secure link to set a new password. Every change is logged in Activity.

stages.title: Case stages
stages.text: The six stages every case passes through. Move a case forward or back here. The same stage shows on the board and is logged in Activity.

next.title: Next action
next.text: The one thing to do for this lead now, worked out from its stage and missing documents. Doing it logs the step in Activity.

docs.title: Documents
docs.text: Everything the case needs. Request emails the applicant, Mark received records a paper copy, and Reject asks for a new upload.

app.title: Application
app.text: The five sections of the applicant's online form. A tick means the section is complete.

answers.title: Eligibility answers
answers.text: What the applicant answered in the eligibility check before contacting us. 'Not recorded' means the answer was not captured.

activity.title: Activity
activity.text: A timeline of this case. Gold dots are actions your team took, with the time. Grey dots are milestones from the case record.

contact.title: Contact
contact.text: Click to email or call the applicant. To change these details, use Edit details & password at the top.

status.title: Status shown to the applicant
status.text: This is the wording the applicant sees in their portal. Changing it sends them an email update.

notes.title: Notes
notes.text: Internal only, never shown to the applicant. Use them for calls, follow-ups and anything a colleague needs to know.

owner.title: Case owner
owner.text: The team member responsible for this case. 'Assign to me' in Next action sets this too.

inbox.title: Inbox
inbox.text: Callback requests from the campaign site and messages from the firm's website forms. Mark an item In progress when you pick it up and Closed when it is dealt with.

weekly.title: Weekly call template
weekly.text: The times at which visitors can book a free call, every week. Capacity is how many calls fit in one slot. Switch a time off to stop offering it without losing it.

blocked.title: Blocked days and slots
blocked.text: Close the calendar for a holiday or a single time. A blocked day offers no slots at all.

team.title: Team
team.text: Everyone with access to this area. Admins can change availability and manage the team; lawyers and case managers work on leads.

calendars.title: Calendars
calendars.text: Each lawyer has a calendar of their own: their weekly hours (one call at a time) and their days off. 'Unassigned (any lawyer)' is the template for calls that are not tied to a lawyer, with a number of calls per slot; a day blocked there is closed for everyone. A new booking goes to a free lawyer first (the one with the fewest calls that week), then to the unassigned template. Admins edit every calendar, lawyers their own.

call.title: Free call
call.text: The applicant's free call and the lawyer it is assigned to. Once its time has come, mark it held or a no-show; a call nobody marks is recorded as held a day later. Cancelling it emails the applicant.

availability.title: Availability
availability.timezone: Times are in the firm's time zone ({timezone}). Calls last {minutes} minutes.
availability.slot: Time (leave empty for the whole day)

errors.invalid: Check the time (HH:MM) and the other values.
errors.generic: Could not save. Please try again.

scopes.label: Calendar
scopes.ownOnly: You can change your own hours only.

team.title: Team
team.lastAdmin: The firm needs at least one active admin.
team.addHint: To add a team member, create the account with the bootstrap script (pnpm bootstrap:admin) and set their role here.

error.text: Something went wrong while reading the data. Check your connection and try again.

erase.title: Delete applicant
erase.text: Permanently removes this applicant's file: details, application, uploaded documents, notes, history, sign-in account and any emails still queued for them, plus callback requests and website enquiries from the same address. This cannot be undone. A record that it happened (case reference, who, when) is kept; it does not name the person.
erase.confirmLabel: To confirm, type the case reference {caseRef}

callPanel.cancelConfirm: Cancel this call? The applicant is emailed that it will not take place.
